en.title: datasette-mcp 0.4
en.summary: datasette-mcp version 0.4 has been released. The new version includes a fix for compatibility with Datasette 1.0a44. The release is tagged with model-context-protocol and datasette.
en.impact: This update could matter to users and developers working with Datasette 1.0a44 and the model context protocol, as it ensures compatibility with the latest version.
